title: Rec league photo day
brief:
You manage a recreational basketball team for children ages nine and ten. Write a group chat message to parents and caregivers about team photos on Sunday. The photographer has moved your slot from 10:40 to 10:20 a.m. at Court 2. The game still starts at 11 a.m. Ask players to arrive at 10:10 wearing their blue jerseys. Families can skip photos and arrive by 10:45 for warmup. Make both arrival times easy to find on a phone.

Aim for 70 to 150 words. Return the complete original work directly in your answer. Do not sign or identify yourself. Do not use tools.

addb54cc81176bc1.text:
Hi everyone! The photographer moved our Sunday team photos up from 10:40 to **10:20 a.m. at Court 2**. Photos are optional. Please have your player wear their blue jersey either way.

- **10:10 a.m. — Arrive for photos.** Meet at Court 2 so we can get everyone together for our 10:20 slot.
- **10:45 a.m. — Arrive for warmup if you’re skipping photos.** You can head straight to warmup when you arrive.

Our game still starts at **11:00 a.m.** See you Sunday!

99e0953f57b1266d.text:
